apps.localizedDescription: 基于 PiliPlus 的个人维护版，保留 BTR 本地 HTTP 代理、多 Range 并发下载、CDN 选择/竞速、设置与日志，并分别定期合并 BTR 作者与 PiliPlus 官方更新。BTR 默认关闭，需在音视频设置中开启。本源跟踪 aierlma/PiliPlus 通过验证后发布的正式未签名 IPA，需自行侧载；应用内更新检查也指向该仓库。

versions.localizedDescription:
PiliPlus BTR **2.1.5573** / build **5573**, based on PiliPlus 2.1.6.

修复海外 Akamai 播放地址的签名处理：直接使用 B 站接口返回的完整 Akamai 地址，保留其专属签名；避免把其他 CDN 地址仅替换域名后交给 Akamai，也避免 BTR 使用之前缓存的测速结果跨域搬用签名。未提供 Akamai 地址时保留原始可用地址。

本版本保留现有 BTR 功能和独立应用标识 `com.example.piliplus.btr`。通过现有 SideStore 订阅更新，无需更换订阅或卸载旧版。最低 iOS 15.0。

Validation:
- [Unsigned iOS build and focused Flutter tests](https://github.com/aierlma/PiliPlus/actions/runs/40249671258)
- [Release checks against the same source](https://github.com/aierlma/PiliPlus/actions/runs/40251105576): 60 Flutter tests, 29 maintenance tests and 17 updater checks passed; full static analysis had no errors or warnings (44 informational lints).
- Live signed video/audio range requests: legacy host rewrite returned 403; fixed direct and BTR paths returned 206 with matching content.
- Device installation and sustained playback will be tested by the user; this release does not claim to eliminate every possible buffering cause.
